Product Features

  • Measuring 180 × 40 × 55 cm, this spacious cabinet can accommodate TVs up to 75 inches. Its large, stable tabletop blends harmoniously into living rooms of any size and creates a stylish ambience.
  • Double-layered, closed cabinets and open shelves on both sides allow for the clear storage of audio and video equipment, various objects and decorative items. Dustproof and easy to access, it will keep your living room neat and tidy.
  • Made of high-quality chipboard, the dense material is dimensionally stable, has a smooth, easy-to-clean surface and is extremely durable - for worry-free daily use.
  • The cabinet supports up to 45 kg, providing a secure hold for large TVs, stereos, and other devices. The even weight distribution prevents bending or sagging, ensuring safe use.
  • Equipped with quiet soft-close hinges, the doors close smoothly and without noise or shock. Opening and closing is smooth and durable, contributing to a quiet and comfortable living experience.
  • The cabinet's low design lowers the center of gravity and increases stability, minimizing the risk of tipping over. It is safe for households with children and pets and offers a high level of safety.
  • The closed cabinets are dust and moisture proof and protect sensitive equipment. The open shelves allow easy access and combine storage and presentation.
  • This multifunctional cabinet can serve as a TV stand, living room cabinet or low cabinet in the entrance area and flexibly adapts to different room situations.
  • Its simple, modern lines harmonize with different interior styles, giving your living room an elegant and timeless look that effortlessly enhances the aesthetics and style of your living room.
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and display devices, there may be slight color variations between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to reproduce the color of the product as faithfully as possible. Please only order if you value color accuracy.

Descriptions

Descriptions

This 180 × 40 × 55 cm TV cabinet is suitable for TVs up to 75 inches. Made of high-quality, environmentally friendly chipboard, it supports up to 45 kg, guaranteeing a stable and durable construction. The double-closed cabinets with open storage compartments on both sides offer plenty of space for clear storage. The closed cabinets are protected against dust and moisture, while the open ones allow easy access. The cabinet doors are equipped with noiseless soft-close hinges. The low-profile design lowers the center of gravity and increases safety. Its simple, modern design fits in with various interior styles and is suitable for both the living room and the entrance area - practical storage space meets aesthetics.
